stem: ![](asset:P000475-stem-1) A ring of mass m can slide over a smooth vertical rod. The ring is connected to a spring of force constant K = 4mg/R where 2R is the natural length of the spring. The other end of the spring is fixed to the ground at a horizontal distance 2R from the base of the rod. The mass is released at a height of 1.5R from ground. Find the velocity of the ring when it reaches the ground.

assets.alt: A ring on a vertical pole at height 3R/2, joined by a spring to point A on the ground, a horizontal distance 2R from the pole.
